Do not reply to unsolicited emails or click suspicious TXT links

Do not reply to unsolicited emails or click suspicious TXT links

 

We’re aware of an email scam reportedly from the Commissioner seeking funds – this is a scam, please ignore it.

There is also a text scam with links to pay a speeding fine, claiming to be from Police – we don’t issue fines via text, don’t click the link.

If you have received a text but have not provided any details and have not suffered a loss, you can report this to Netsafe, or forward the text to DIA 7726 - Report TXT spam. If you have clicked on the link and provided your details, you can report this to Police online.

New Zealand Police Home

111

Emergency

One-One-One (111)

Call triple one (111) when you need an emergency response from Police, Fire or Ambulance.

If you have difficulty hearing or talking on the phone you can register here for the 111 TXT service.

About 111

105

Non-Emergency

Ten Five (105)

Use Ten Five (105) to report things that don’t need urgent Police assistance.

Use 105

*555

Driving Incidents

Star Triple Five (*555)

Call Star Triple Five (*555) to report road incidents which are urgent but not life-threatening.

About *555

Call Crime Stoppers to report a crime anonymously. Crime Stoppers is an independent charity.
